parties: GeeCee Ventures Limited (acquirer) | GMR Power and Urban Infra Limited (target)
headline: GeeCee Ventures acquires equity stake in GMR Power and Urban Infra Limited
sum: GeeCee Ventures Limited announced acquisition of equity shares in GMR Power and Urban Infra Limited, disclosed to NSE under SEBI LODR Regulation 30 as a material general update.
implication: Reg. 30 disclosure requirement triggers for listed acquirer; review whether GMR Power is listed or unlisted and whether stake crosses 20% / 25% thresholds requiring separate shareholding pattern disclosure or open offer obligations.
detail: GeeCee Ventures Limited disclosed acquisition of equity shares in GMR Power and Urban Infra Limited to the National Stock Exchange under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The acquisition qualifies as a 'general update' requiring exchange notification. Specific deal value, number of shares acquired, and resultant shareholding percentage not disclosed in the headline summary; full details expected in the linked PDF filing.

framework.ref: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 – Regulation 30
framework.note: central - Material event disclosure requirement for listed entities; governs timing (within 30 mins of board decision or before market opening, whichever is earlier) and content of acquisition announcements.

framework.ref: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 – Regulation 31 & Schedule III
framework.note: central - Shareholding pattern disclosure norms post-acquisition; if target is listed, cross-shareholding disclosure required.

framework.ref: Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992 – Section 11
framework.note: central - SEBI's regulatory authority over listed entities and acquisition compliance.
central - Definition of 'acquisition', parties, and statutory approvals if stake exceeds 25% or triggers minority protections.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 – Sections 4, 5, 6
framework.note: central - Open offer / disclosure obligation if acquirer's stake reaches or exceeds 25% post-acquisition.
- CCI notification may be required if combined turnover of parties exceeds statutory thresholds; GMR Power's scale suggests potential notification.
- If GeeCee Ventures has foreign shareholding, cross-border transaction compliance under FDI rules.

framework.ref: Income Tax Act, 1961 – Section 49, 55, Schedule VI
framework.note: - Stamp duty, TDS on acquisition consideration, and indexation cost basis for future capital gains.
